stage: D006 discovery-only evidence-support feasibility; no relationship ranking or models
coverage_status: comparison settings only; not final eligibility or reliability thresholds
stress_operator: strictly greater than own historical quantile; history ends t-1
missing_current_or_baseline: unknown state; never fill as nonstress
backward_five_rv: sqrt(sum of last five log-return squares ending today)); require five observed returns
market_context: D004 conservative donors, exact focal/pair leave-out; no new optimized contexts
severity_diagnostic: split discovery global-decline median donor return at its discovery median; diagnostic only, not a deployable frozen context
pair_support_universe: all names with any conservative discovery return; no D004 screen or pair coefficients
pair_outputs: anonymous aggregate count/coverage distributions only; no CVR estimates, identifiers or rankings
uncertainty: 1000 whole-calendar decline-block resamples for per-stock stress-frequency feasibility, conditional on fixed historical states; no calibrated pair interval or significance claim
simulations: 10000 synthetic experiments each: iid independent A/C with p=0.1/0.3/0.5; episode-constant independent A/C p=0.3; severity-mixture conditionally independent p=0.1/0.8
later_relationship_data: not read; no targets or later columns
lead_approval_pending: final operational definitions, reliability criteria, discovery relationship assessment and later replication
authorship: human supplied D006 approval/objective; AI supplied this disclosed feasibility grid and implementation
